query:
INSERT INTO sessions (
            user_id,
            device_id,
            family_id,
            stage,
            mfa_verified_at,
            access_hash,
            access_expires_at,
            refresh_hash,
            refresh_expires_at,
            idle_expires_at
        )
        VALUES (
            $1::text::uuid,
            $2::text::uuid,
            gen_random_uuid(),
            1,
            NULL,
            $3,
            now() + interval '5 minutes',
            NULL,
            NULL,
            NULL
        )
        RETURNING
            id::text AS "id!",
            family_id::text AS "family_id!"
